name: Tres Dawg
summary: **Tres Dawg** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Top Dawg Seeds]], a cross of [[chemdawg-d|Chem D]] and [[double-dawg|Double Dawg]]. Double Dawg is itself Chem D backcrossed onto a cross of Chem D and [[afghani-1|Afghani #1]]. Crossed with [[chemdawg-4|Chemdawg 4]], Tres Dawg later parented [[stardawg|Stardawg]].

sources.title: Tres Dawg (Top Dawg Seeds)
sources.note: L1-C audit 2026-09-25: gives Top Dawg Seeds and Chem D x Double Dawg, with Double Dawg as Chem D x (Chem D x Afghani #1).
